title: Modification to achieve settlor's tax objectives.
bodyText: To achieve the settlor's tax objectives, the court may modify the terms of a trust in a manner that is not contrary to the settlor's probable intention. The court may provide that the modification has retroactive effect.
bodyHtml: [§554D-416]  Modification to achieve settlor's tax objectives.  To achieve the settlor's tax objectives, the court may modify the terms of a trust in a manner that is not contrary to the settlor's probable intention.  The court may provide that the modification has retroactive effect. [L 2021, c 32, pt of §2]
